title: Record-marked stream whose only record mark has the last-fragment bit clear
caps_note: An encoding rule of RFC 5531 record marking, not a CAP.
why: stellar-core writes every record as one last fragment; a reader that joins fragments reads a stream core never writes.

source.recipe: base entry frame 0 with bit 31 of its record mark cleared
source.reason: stellar-core sets the last-fragment bit on every record it writes
